prompt:

Upper 30% and lower 25% of the frame remain calm, clean warm uncoated newsprint/butcher paper space so typography can be overlaid cleanly later.
CRITICAL RULES: ZERO text, ZERO letters, ZERO numbers, ZERO words, ZERO stickers with writing, ZERO logos, ZERO watermarks anywhere in the image. Crisp tactile 35mm magazine craft photography.
